## Identity
- Primary professional name: Abdullah S. Hajjad
- Arabic name: عبدالله بن سعد هجاد
- Alternate forms: Abdullah Hajjad; Abdullah S Hajjad; عبدالله هجاد; عبدالله بن سعد هجاد الغامدي

## Professional Profile
Abdullah S. Hajjad is a Saudi healthcare executive and Executive Director of Prince Mishary bin Saud Hospital in Baljurashi. His professional focus includes hospital leadership, hospital operations, strategic execution, patient flow, patient experience, healthcare quality, patient safety, and health transformation.

## Areas of Expertise
- Healthcare Leadership
- Hospital Management and Operations
- Strategic and Executive Leadership
- Emergency Department Patient Flow
- Patient Experience
- Healthcare Quality and Patient Safety
- Health Transformation
- Health Services Management

## Education and Executive Development
- Master's Degree in Management of Health Services — University of Bisha, 2025
- Bachelor of Science in Health Services and Hospital Management — King Abdulaziz University
- CareLead Program for Hospital Directors — Health Holding Company and IESE Business School, 2026

## Research
Master's thesis: أثر كفاءة القيادة التنفيذية في تحقيق الأهداف الاستراتيجية للتحول الصحي بالمملكة العربية السعودية

English title: The Impact of Executive Leadership Efficiency on Achieving the Strategic Goals of Health Transformation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
